versions.content: function RegisterStatusChangeNotifier [SWS_TS_01010] Upstream: RS_TS_00034 void RegisterStatusChangeNotifier ( SynchronizedTimeBaseNotifier notifier) noexcept; Register a notifier function which is called if a StatusFlag is changed (i.e. synchronization state, time leap or userdata). A maximum of one notifier can be registered. Every further registration overwrites the current registration.
